note: Recovered runtime/entity metadata and retail stage resource bindings shared by runtime and browser tools. Stage bindings describe what retail loads; they are not yet a complete semantic/global asset library.

entities.name: Area Bomb
entities.effect: pickup grants +1 charge at inventory+0x30 (cap 9) and selects secondary mode 4; activation uses template 0x0048EE80; 0x00448B70 emits 16 radial 0xA3 effects and applies a 5x5 local destructible-cell sweep; object does not travel

entities.name: Spike Ball
entities.effect: calls 0x00449D00(actor,1), increments inventory+0x40 and spawns template 0x0048EF10; runtime continuously orbits owner without target acquisition

entities.name: Shield (rear-firing/upgraded behavior)
entities.effect: calls 0x00449D00(actor,2), increments inventory+0x44 and spawns template 0x0048EFA0; runtime stays behind owner and fires projectile 0x0048EF58 rearward while owner fires

entities.name: Power Level 2
entities.effect: select weapon slot 1; set inventory+0x14 firing reserve to 0x1000

entities.name: Power Level 3
entities.effect: select weapon slot 2; set inventory+0x18 firing reserve to 0x1000

entities.name: Invulnerability
entities.effect: actor+0x230 = 0x384 (900); ordinary damage rejected while nonzero except raw damage 0xFF bypass

entities.name: Unknown timed HUD status (type 19)
entities.effect: actor+0x244 = 0x384 (900); global actor update decrements it once per active actor-update pass; HUD 0x00443F03 reads the same field through actor-pool absolute address 0x0062061C, divides by 30, and displays the remaining count/30 value; no non-HUD gameplay consumer recovered

entities.name: Homing Spike Ball
entities.effect: calls 0x00449D00(actor,3), increments inventory+0x48 and spawns template 0x0048EFE8; runtime searches for nearby actors and steers/orbits toward a target

entities.name: Mines
entities.effect: pickup grants +3 charges at inventory+0x34 (cap 9) and selects secondary mode 5; activation uses template 0x0048EE38; mine initializes lifetime/fuse 150, settles on world collision, explodes through actor/terminal callback or when countdown reaches <=2, and applies a 3x3 local destructible-cell sweep

entities.name: Ambient SFX emitter
entities.preview: spatial audio preview when available; selector must resolve through base-level ambient profile table

entities.name: Energy
entities.effect: current HP += max HP >> 2; clamp to max HP (Windows EXE = +25% max HP)

entities.name: Bubble emitter
entities.preview: spawn frame 189; rise +0x20000 Z/update; random X/Y wander +/-0x20000

entities.name: Fire particle emitter
entities.preview: random orientation for A7; +/-0x20 local scatter; A7 short fade, 7D rises +0x38000 and fades

entities.name: Smoke emitter
entities.preview: spawn with +/-0x20 local X/Y scatter; rise +0x38000 Z/update; fade byte -4/update

entities.name: TNT_MINE mission object
entities.effect: increment ITEMS; sound 0x148; append reference/value to 0x004B6A48 and increment mission progress 0x004B92B0

environment_emitters.name: Ambient SFX emitter
environment_emitters.spawn_effects: audio profile selected by type_word bits 9..13
environment_emitters.cadence: profile/shared-state dependent; update gated by global tick low nibble
environment_emitters.editor_preview: spatial audio preview when available; selector must resolve through base-level ambient profile table
environment_emitters.notes: actor+0x248 points to shared 10-byte ambient profile; actor+0x250 receives type_word>>14; SFX and AMBIENT SFX settings gate initialization/update

environment_emitters.name: Bubble emitter
environment_emitters.editor_preview: spawn frame 189; rise +0x20000 Z/update; random X/Y wander +/-0x20000
environment_emitters.notes: 259/265 retail placements are on class 0x0A00 or 0x0200 damage cells; emitter itself supplies no damage

environment_emitters.name: Fire particle emitter

environment_emitters.editor_preview: random orientation for A7; +/-0x20 local scatter; A7 short fade, 7D rises +0x38000 and fades
environment_emitters.notes: 61/70 retail placements sit on class 0x0200 damage cells; same A7/7D family is used by Fire Starter incinerator effects

environment_emitters.name: Smoke emitter
